questions.q_en: If f{p} = sin x+ cos x, then find 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0}?
questions.q_hi: यदि f{p} = sin x+ cos x तो 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0} ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution_en:
If f{p} = sin x+ cos x
Then, f{0} = sin2 x+ cos2 x =1
F{2} = sin4 x+ cos4 x =1-2sin2 x cos2 x
F{4} = sin6 x+ cos6 x =1-3sin2 x cos2 x
Now required value : 6f{2} – 4f{4} + 10f {0} =
6 [1-2sin2 x cos2 x] – 4[1-3sin2 x cos2 x]+10×1
=6-12sin2 x cos2 x-4+12sin2 x cos2 x+10= 12
questions.solution_hi:
यदि f{p} = sin x+ cos x
